sources.title: TinyFlow: Breaking the Warping Bottleneck for Edge Optical Flow
sources.version: v1, 2026-10-23, preprint submitted to IEEE; not verified as a published conference paper
sources.relevance: Fixed-offset correlation, coarse-to-fine flow and teacher distillation already have explicit edge-deployment prior art. The flow estimator avoiding warping does not eliminate an enhancement system's final image resampling.
sources.not_done: No code execution, quantization, compiler validation or transfer of author benchmark numbers.

sources.title: Optical Flow Distillation: Towards Efficient and Stable Video Style Transfer
sources.relevance: Residual output and low-rank temporal distillation precede this project. Its student consumes a current frame; that differs from retaining a small learned motion estimator and a recurrent RGB state.
sources.not_done: No reproduction, new style-transfer experiment or adoption of published speed figures as our measurements.

sources.title: FlowAnyTime: Efficient Fine-tuning with Intra-Inter Frame Distillation for All-Weather Optical Flow Estimation

existing_project_reading_retained: note24 STBN already covers privileged flow distillation and independence caveats; note53 covers recurrent filtering and note48 covers lightweight recurrent enhancement.
novelty_conclusion: Neither motion supervision, a tiny matcher, RGB recurrence nor teacher distillation alone is new. Next pilot tests usefulness and cost, not established novelty.
